sections.title: Mental model
sections.body:
Angular state ≈ React state but **observable-shaped**.

- **Local** — component fields + signals.
- **Service singletons** — for shared state (`providedIn: 'root'`).
- **NgRx** for redux-style; **Akita** / **Component Store** for lighter alternatives.
- **Testing** — TestBed, ComponentFixture, marble tests for RxJS, e2e with Playwright.

sections.title: Must-know concepts
sections.body:
The interview surface for this module breaks into these focus areas:

- **Ngrx fundamentals** — drill the named patterns, the failure modes, and the recommended Java / framework idiom.
- **Ngrx effects and selectors** — drill the named patterns, the failure modes, and the recommended Java / framework idiom.
- **Ngrx component store** — drill the named patterns, the failure modes, and the recommended Java / framework idiom.
- **Akita and alternatives** — drill the named patterns, the failure modes, and the recommended Java / framework idiom.
- **Testbed and unit testing** — drill the named patterns, the failure modes, and the recommended Java / framework idiom.
- **Karma and jasmine** — drill the named patterns, the failure modes, and the recommended Java / framework idiom.
- **Component testing** — drill the named patterns, the failure modes, and the recommended Java / framework idiom.
- **E2e with cypress** — drill the named patterns, the failure modes, and the recommended Java / framework idiom.
- **Comparisons** — drill the named patterns, the failure modes, and the recommended Java / framework idiom.
- **Scenario-based** — applied questions tying multiple topics together. Drill these *last*, after the fundamentals are sharp.

sections.title: Likely interview hooks
sections.body:
- **NgRx is heavy** — only justify it on apps with truly shared, derived state.
- **`provideHttpClient(withFetch())`** + standalone testing setup is the modern pattern.
- **Marble tests** — read like ASCII art; powerful for time-based RxJS.
- **Spectator** — reduces TestBed boilerplate.
- **Component testing** with Cypress Component Test Runner is gaining traction.

sections.title: Speaking template
sections.body: > *"For state I'd start with services + signals, escalate to Component Store for feature-scoped stores, and reach for NgRx only when several features share derived state. Tests run in TestBed with marble tests for RxJS-heavy logic."*
